# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:config` from src/config/settings.ts. Do not edit by hand; a test checks it. -->

Every setting has a default, so premise runs with no configuration at all. Change a setting in one of two ways:

- **The settings file:** `config.json` in the data folder, one JSON object. A dotted key is a nested object: `queue.max_agent_sessions` is `{ "queue": { "max_agent_sessions": 3 } }`.
- **An environment variable:** `PREMISE_` and the key in capitals, each dot as a double underscore: `PREMISE_QUEUE__MAX_AGENT_SESSIONS=3`. Environment variables win over the file.

The data folder itself is set by `--data <folder>`, then `PREMISE_DATA_FOLDER`, then `.premise` in your home folder, because the settings file lives inside it.

A wrong setting stops premise at start with a message naming the setting and why. `premise doctor` checks the settings without starting anything.

## General

| Setting | Default | Allowed | Meaning | Record |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server.host` | `"127.0.0.1"` | one of 127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost | Address the page and API listen on. Only this machine. | [0144](../decisions/README.md) |
| `server.port` | `4610` | 1 to 65535 | Port for the page and API. |  |
| `server.token_bytes` | `32` | 16 to 128 | Length in bytes of the random token in the session link. | [0078](../decisions/README.md) |
| `data.keep_finished_working_copies` | `false` | true or false | Keep agents' working copies after their job ends, for inspection. |  |
| `queue.max_agent_sessions` | `2` | 1 to 16 | How many agent sessions run at once. | [0074](../decisions/README.md) |
| `queue.same_failure_limit` | `3` | 1 to 20 | How many times the same failure may happen before a job ends stuck. | [0088](../decisions/README.md) |
| `queue.usage_pause_fallback_minutes` | `60` | 1 to 1440 | How long agent work pauses after a usage-limit event that gives no reset time. |  |
| `agents.mode` | `"scripted"` | "scripted" or "claude" | "scripted": a stand-in agent that follows a script file and calls no AI. "claude": real Claude Code sessions on your Claude Code login, each confined by Claude Code's sandbox (needs bubblewrap and socat on Linux). | [0134](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.claude_config_folder` | `null` | a folder path, or null | Claude Code configuration folder to use. null means your existing Claude Code login. | [0140](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.claude.command` | `"claude"` | a program name or path | The Claude Code program to run for real agents. "claude" means the one found on your PATH. | [0071](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.claude.stop_grace_seconds` | `10` | 1 to 300 | When a real agent session is stopped, how long it gets to end by itself before it is ended forcibly. |  |
| `agents.network.allowed_domains` | `["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","index.crates.io","proxy.golang.org","sum.golang.org"]` | a list of host names | Hosts that build, prototype and check sessions may reach (package registries). Other sessions reach no host. | [0087](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.confinement.extra_denied_paths` | `[]` | a list of folder or file paths | More folders or files real agents may never read or write, besides premise's data folder and the usual credential files (SSH keys, GitHub and Claude Code logins, cloud credentials). | [0087](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.scripted.script_file` | `null` | a file path, or null | JSON script the scripted agent follows. null means every job ends done after agents.scripted.step_seconds. | [0148](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.scripted.step_seconds` | `2` | 0 to 600 | When no script file is set: how long each scripted job takes, so you can watch work move on the page. 0 finishes every job at once. | [0154](../decisions/README.md) |
| `tools.progress_max_chars` | `200` | 20 to 2000 | Longest progress line an agent may send; longer lines are cut. |  |
| `tools.ask_max_items` | `10` | 1 to 50 | Most items an agent may put in one question to a person. |  |
| `usage_ledger.mode` | `"mock-fixed"` | "mock-fixed", "mock-random" or "real" (not built yet) | Where usage figures come from. "mock-fixed": the same made-up figures every time. "mock-random": made-up figures from a seed. Mocked figures are labelled on the page. | [0133](../decisions/README.md) |
| `usage_ledger.seed` | `null` | a whole number, or null | Seed for "mock-random". null means a new seed each time premise starts. | [0133](../decisions/README.md) |
| `softwares.default_priority` | `3` | 1 (most important) to 5 | Priority a new software gets. The work queue starts the most important first. | [0138](../decisions/README.md) |
| `softwares.default_milestone_waits` | `false` | true or false | Whether a new software stops after each of its milestones until you say go on. | [0129](../decisions/README.md) |
| `softwares.default_weekly_share_percent` | `null` | 1 to 100, or null | Share of weekly usage a new software may use. null means no share is set. | [0128](../decisions/README.md) |
| `page.notifications` | `"offer"` | "offer" or "off" | "offer": the page offers browser notifications for new questions, and asks the browser only when you accept. "off": it never offers them. | [0157](../decisions/README.md) |
| `record.folder` | `"premise"` | a folder name with letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores | Name of the folder at the root of each software's repository that holds its record. | [0080](../decisions/README.md) |
| `record.trailer` | `"Premise-Trace"` | letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter | Name of the line every commit premise makes carries, naming the record items the commit serves. | [0083](../decisions/README.md) |
| `record.default_branch` | `"main"` | a branch name with letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores or slashes | Branch name a new software's repository starts on. | [0159](../decisions/README.md) |
| `record.commit_author_name` | `"premise"` | a name | Name on the commits premise makes in a software's repository. | [0159](../decisions/README.md) |
| `record.commit_author_email` | `"premise@localhost"` | an address | Address on the commits premise makes in a software's repository. The repository may be public, so keep it free of personal addresses. | [0159](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.restart_limit` | `3` | 0 to 50 | How many times a crashed software is started again within the window below before premise stops trying and reports it. 0 never restarts. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.restart_window_minutes` | `10` | 1 to 1440 | The window, in minutes, in which restarts count towards the limit. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.restart_delay_seconds` | `2` | 0 to 600 | How long to wait before starting a crashed software again. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.port_range` | `"4700-4799"` | two ports joined by a dash, such as "4700-4799" | Ports on this machine that running web software may use. Software is only ever reachable from this machine. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.start_timeout_seconds` | `30` | 1 to 600 | How long a web software has to start answering before the start is called failed. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.sample_timeout_seconds` | `30` | 1 to 600 | How long a command-line software's sample run may take. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.stop_grace_seconds` | `5` | 0 to 120 | When running software is stopped, how long it gets to end by itself before it is ended forcibly. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.output_lines` | `200` | 10 to 5000 | How many of the latest lines of a running software's output the page can show. | [0162](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.confinement` | `"bubblewrap"` | "bubblewrap" or "none" | "bubblewrap": running software sees only its own copy of the code, not your files or premise's data. "none": no confinement, only for a machine where bubblewrap cannot work; premise says so on the page. | [0163](../decisions/README.md) |
| `runner.read_only_paths` | `[]` | a list of folder paths | Extra folders running software may read but not change, such as where Node.js or Python is installed when that is under your home folder. | [0163](../decisions/README.md) |
| `reports.max_lines` | `15` | 3 to 200 | How many lines a short report holds before the rest is behind the page's 'Show more detail' control. | [0164](../decisions/README.md) |
| `doctor.command_timeout_seconds` | `10` | 1 to 120 | How long the setup check waits for each program to answer. |  |

## Per type of task

Each type of agent task has its own model, effort and limits. The types are: draft, research, review, plan, build, prototype, check, triage, reading, report.

| Setting | Default | Allowed | Meaning | Record |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agents.tasks.draft.model` | `"opus"` | a model alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or a full model name | Model for draft sessions. Strongest tier by default. | [0104](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.tasks.draft.effort` | `"medium"` | low, medium, high, xhigh, max | Reasoning effort for draft sessions. | [0132](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.tasks.draft.max_turns` | `60` | 1 to 2000 | Turn limit for one draft session; at the limit the job ends stuck. | [0088](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.tasks.draft.max_minutes` | `20` | 1 to 1440 | Time limit in minutes for one draft session. | [0088](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.tasks.research.model` | `"opus"` | a model alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or a full model name | Model for research sessions. Strongest tier by default. | [0104](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.tasks.research.effort` | `"medium"` | low, medium, high, xhigh, max | Reasoning effort for research sessions. | [0132](../decisions/README.md) |
| `agents.tasks.research.max_turns` | `60` | 1 to 2000 | Turn limit for one research session; at the limit the job ends stuck. | [0088](../decisions/README.md) |
